# Calibrating across heart rates (generated by scripts/heart_rate.py)

SensSmartTech, CEBS final U-Net, 3 seeds, 100 fine-tuning steps. Same test recordings for every method. Per person first, then averaged.

## rest recordings

| method    |   people |     r |   beat_se |   beat_ppv |   r_timing_abs_ms |   template_r |   beat_r |
|:----------|---------:|------:|----------:|-----------:|------------------:|-------------:|---------:|
| rest_10s  |       31 | 0.863 |     0.983 |      0.987 |             2.62  |        0.973 |    0.914 |
| rest_20s  |       31 | 0.889 |     0.986 |      0.989 |             2.222 |        0.981 |    0.936 |
| rest_fast |       31 | 0.847 |     0.981 |      0.985 |             2.948 |        0.968 |    0.899 |
| rest_warp |       31 | 0.858 |     0.98  |      0.983 |             2.604 |        0.967 |    0.907 |

- rest_20s vs rest_10s: better for 30 of 31 people; mean r difference +0.026; Wilcoxon p = 2.79e-09
- rest_fast vs rest_10s: better for 7 of 31 people; mean r difference -0.016; Wilcoxon p = 0.00116
- rest_warp vs rest_10s: better for 10 of 31 people; mean r difference -0.005; Wilcoxon p = 0.12
